name: Infantry
description: Equipment, protection and sensors for infantry.

techs.name: Modern assault rifles and radios
techs.description: Standard rifles, radios and helmets for a modern army.

techs.name: Handheld satellite navigation
techs.description: Satellite navigation receivers issued to small units.

techs.name: Improved body armour
techs.description: Lighter ceramic plates and helmets for every soldier.

techs.name: Night vision for all units
techs.description: Image-intensifier and thermal sights issued down to squad level.

techs.name: Modular load-carrying equipment
techs.description: Vests and packs that carry ammunition, water and radios more evenly.

techs.name: Thermal weapon sights
techs.description: Rifle and machine-gun sights that see heat through smoke and darkness.

techs.name: Software-defined tactical radios
techs.description: Radios that carry voice and data on several waveforms.

techs.name: Fire-and-forget anti-tank missiles
techs.description: Portable guided missiles that do not need guiding to the target.

techs.name: Counter-IED equipment
techs.description: Jammers, detectors and route-clearance kits against roadside bombs.

techs.name: Digitised infantry
techs.description: Radios, displays and positioning for every squad.

techs.name: Mine-resistant vehicles
techs.description: Protected vehicles against mines and roadside bombs.

techs.name: Tactical combat casualty care
techs.description: Tourniquets, haemostatic dressings and medics trained to treat wounds under fire.

techs.name: Designated marksman rifles
techs.description: Accurate semi-automatic rifles for one marksman in each squad.

techs.name: Blue-force tracking
techs.description: Every friendly unit shown on a shared digital map.

techs.name: Lightweight precision mortars
techs.description: Light mortars with guided bombs for small units.

techs.name: Rugged battlefield tablets
techs.description: Hardened tablets for maps, orders and fire requests.

techs.name: Lightweight plate carriers
techs.description: Thinner, lighter armour plates that cover more of the body.

techs.name: Hand-held counter-drone jammers
techs.description: Portable jammers that break the link between a drone and its operator.

techs.name: Squad reconnaissance drones
techs.description: Small drones for scouting at platoon and squad level.

techs.name: Suppressed small arms
techs.description: Rifles and machine guns fitted with suppressors as standard.

techs.name: Light tactical vehicles
techs.description: Fast, lightly protected vehicles for moving infantry.

techs.name: Mobile mesh networks
techs.description: Radios that pass data from soldier to soldier without a base station.

techs.name: Next-generation squad weapons
techs.description: A new rifle and light machine gun in a more powerful calibre.

techs.name: Rifle modernisation programme
techs.description: Better optics, rails and ammunition for the rifles already in service.

techs.name: First-person-view attack drones
techs.description: Cheap racing drones carrying explosives, flown by video link.

techs.name: Augmented-reality sights
techs.description: Head-mounted displays that overlay targets and routes.

techs.name: Portable loitering munitions
techs.description: Man-portable drones that strike targets they find.

techs.name: Man-portable electronic warfare
techs.description: Backpack jammers and detectors against drones and radios.

techs.name: Thermal signature suppression
techs.description: Clothing and nets that hide soldiers from thermal cameras.

techs.name: Robotic load carriers
techs.description: Small unmanned vehicles that carry supplies and casualties.

techs.name: AI-assisted fire control
techs.description: Sights that track targets and calculate the shot.

techs.name: Tactical battlefield cloud
techs.description: Shared data and computing carried by vehicles at the front.

techs.name: Programmable airburst munitions
techs.description: Grenades and rounds set to burst above a target in cover.

techs.name: Personal counter-drone protection
techs.description: Detectors and interceptors carried by every squad.

techs.name: Human-machine teaming
techs.description: Squads that fight alongside robots and drones under their control.

techs.name: Autonomous drone squads
techs.description: Drone teams that search and strike with little human input.

techs.name: Load-bearing exoskeletons
techs.description: Powered frames that let soldiers carry more for longer.
